# Astra Nexora

> Astra Nexora (AstraNexora) is a digital marketing agency in Tamil Nadu, India. Tagline: Next Era in Digital Marketing. Founded in 2025 by S. Saktheeswaran (Sakthi), Founder & Managing Director (portfolio: https://saktheeswaran.netlify.app/). Serves businesses across India.

## Services
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/seo.html): Rank on Google, maps and AI search
- [Social Media Marketing](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/social-media-marketing.html): Grow and engage your audience
- [Performance Marketing & Paid Ads](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/performance-marketing.html): Google, Meta and LinkedIn ads
- [Content Marketing & Creative](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/content-marketing.html): Copy, design and video
- [Website Design & Development](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/website-development.html): Fast websites that convert
- [Branding & Personal Branding](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/branding.html): Identities and personal brands
- [Email & Lead Generation](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/email-lead-generation.html): Funnels, email and nurturing
- [AI Solutions & Marketing Automation](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/ai-automation.html): Chatbots, n8n and WhatsApp
- [Automated Lead Generation & Outreach](https://astranexora.netlify.app/services/lead-generation-automation.html): Find and email new clients on autopilot

## Blog
- [How to choose a digital marketing agency in Tamil Nadu](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/digital-marketing-agency-tamil-nadu.html): Looking for a digital marketing agency in Tamil Nadu? What a good agency should do, the questions to ask, red flags to avoid and what results to expect.
- [Digital marketing for dentists: how clinics get more patients](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/digital-marketing-for-dentists.html): A practical digital marketing plan for dental clinics: treatment pages, local SEO, Google Business Profile, reviews, ads, social media and WhatsApp booking.
- [Google Ads for small business in India: a practical guide](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/google-ads-small-business-india.html): How small businesses in India can use Google Ads to get calls and enquiries: campaign types, budgets, keywords, landing pages and the mistakes that waste money.
- [SEO services cost in India: what you should pay in 2026](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/seo-services-cost-india.html): How much do SEO services cost in India? What decides the price, monthly vs one-time SEO, what should be included and how to spot cheap SEO that does harm.
- [Website design cost in Tamil Nadu: what you'll pay and why](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/website-design-cost-tamil-nadu.html): How much does a business website cost in Tamil Nadu? What affects the price, WordPress vs Wix vs custom, what's included and hidden costs to ask about.
- [WhatsApp marketing and automation for small businesses](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/whatsapp-marketing-automation-small-business.html): How small businesses in India can use WhatsApp to get more enquiries and bookings: click-to-chat, pre-filled booking forms, catalogues, broadcasts and automation.
- [How to show up in ChatGPT and Google AI answers: AEO and GEO explained](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/ai-search-optimization.html): People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews instead of scrolling results. Here is what AEO and GEO mean and what you can do to be the answer.
- [Google Business Profile: set it up and get found on Maps](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/google-business-profile-guide.html): A plain guide to setting up and improving your Google Business Profile: categories, services, photos, reviews, posts and the mistakes that cost you calls.
- [Local SEO for small businesses: a step-by-step guide](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/local-seo-guide.html): How to show up when people nearby search for what you sell: Google Business Profile, location pages, reviews, citations and the website fixes that matter.
- [SEO vs Google Ads: which should a small business start with?](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/seo-vs-google-ads.html): SEO builds free traffic over time; Google Ads buys traffic today. How each works, what each costs you, and how to decide where to start.
- [Website audit checklist: 12 things to check before you spend on ads](https://astranexora.netlify.app/blog/website-audit-checklist.html): A practical 12-point website audit for business owners: speed, mobile, Google visibility, trust and enquiries. Fix these before you pay for traffic.
